definitions.explanation: A distinct section of a piece of writing, usually dealing with a single theme or idea.

definitions.gloss: end of a phase; conclusion of a stage
definitions.explanation: A natural stopping point or conclusion of a process or task. Often used in the expression {一段落|いちだんらく} to mean reaching a point where one can pause.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{段落|だんらく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{段落|だんらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: This passage is divided into three paragraphs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作文|さくぶん}→作文：02884_sakubun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{段落|だんらく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分|わ}け→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When writing an essay, pay attention to how you divide paragraphs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一段落|いちだんらく}→一段落：15685_ichidanraku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The work has reached a stopping point.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{一段落|いちだんらく}→一段落：15685_ichidanraku⟧ついた。

examples.english: Once the busy period wraps up, I want to go on a trip.

notes:
Has two distinct uses: as a writing term for paragraph, and in the compound ⟦{一段落|いちだんらく}→一段落：15685_ichidanraku⟧ meaning the end of a phase.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {段落|だんらく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ (to divide into paragraphs)
- ⟦{一段落|いちだんらく}→一段落：15685_ichidanraku⟧つく (to reach a stopping point)
- ⟦{一段落|いちだんらく}→一段落：15685_ichidanraku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to settle down, to wrap up a phase)

PRONUNCIATION:
The compound ⟦{一段落|いちだんらく}→一段落：15685_ichidanraku⟧ is traditionally read いちだんらく, though the reading ひとだんらく is also widely used in spoken Japanese.
